page.layout: One column at the top: a numbered list of thesis titles, lines 5 to 18, with a reference mark beside some. Below it a horizontal rule. Then a centred heading "SECT. I.". Below that one column of running text, which continues onto the next page. Page number at top right. Running head at top centre.

main_text.l: 8. Quo sensu juramenta spontanea sint intelligenda.
11. Quatenus juramenti sensus pendeat ex scopo.
14. Cum juratur res licita ob malū finem[?].
15. An obligetur jurans non intendens jurare ?
17. Cum quis dubius est juraverit, nec ne.
main_text.head: SECT. I.
main_text.p: Formam Juramenti tractandam propofuimus duplicem; Externam, & Internam. Externa fignorum & verborum, quæ exteriore fenfu percipiuntur, rationem continet: quam fuperiore le-ctione abfolvimus. Internam, quæ in verborum fenfu & interpretatione, quod eft interioris mentis opus, confiftit, nunc aggre-
[?] Reading of the reference mark uncertain.

page.notes: The top list lines are printed in italic with a rule below them, which separates the list from the section. The mark before item 5 and the item 14 word "malū" are doubtful. The word "aggre-" is cut off by the scan edge at the foot and continues on the next page. Heading "SECT. I." is level 1 with caput 1, as it names a division.
